experiment_data.hypothesis: Trained dt_embedding with subsample (008d-equivalent) in Hopper Hop will trigger CIVO onset (NVE > 1.5× after 35K steps), consistent with Walker (3/3) and Cheetah (3/4). Source: C2 third-environment verification (D160).
